claim: At commit 5f7e383ae6d the C++ MDS never creates an MDLockCache for a directory, so it never grants the directory-operation caps CEPH_CAP_DIR_CREATE (Dc = Fc) / CEPH_CAP_DIR_UNLINK (Dr = Fr) to clients; kernel-client asynchronous create/unlink (nowsync / async dirops) therefore never happens and those operations always go synchronously to the MDS.
basis: Code reading of the MDS, the Linux kernel client (7.3.0-rc6 snapshot) and libcephfs, cross-checked with git history. No test covers it and it was not observed at runtime.
refinements: Precise form: the MDS never grants Dc/Dr on any directory Capability. Snapshot replies are masked too, because directories are multiversion head inodes (src/mds/CInode.cc:4201-4203; src/mds/CInode.h:487-492; src/mds/MDCache.cc:1701-1754 (MDCache::journal_cow_dentry)).

Cap import is not a separate way in. It merges only a Capability::Export that make_export built from another rank's live cap, and that cap obeys the same mask (src/mds/CInode.cc:3705-3709; src/mds/Migrator.cc:3282, 3583; src/mds/MDCache.cc:5585).
The only unmasked way in is CInode::reconnect_cap, which trusts the issued bits the client reports (src/mds/CInode.cc:3676-3690). Unmodified clients never report Dc/Dr there.
Directories add back lock_cache_allowed only when Fx is also allowed (src/mds/Locker.cc:2565; src/mds/CInode.cc:3820).

Release scope: the gate is in squid v19.1.0+ (backport 9d7f5b041b7), in v20.x and on main. reef v18.2.x does not have it (checked by grepping tags v18.2.4, v18.2.8, v19.1.0, v19.2.0, v19.2.3, v20.1.0, v20.2.0).

Wording fix for 'no later commit touches create_lock_cache': the function body is unchanged since 9b4a93f2b7b. a86ee496be9 (PR #61250, merged 2025-01-27) wrapped both call sites in 'mds_allow_async_dirops &&' and did not change the cycle.

Outside scope: a modified client that claims Dc/Dr at reconnect, or a cap export from a pre-gate (reef) rank during a mixed-version upgrade, could seed issued(). The cycle would then keep itself going.
evidence: src/mds/Locker.cc:1124-1128 (Locker::create_lock_cache): returns unless cap->issued() & get_cap_bit_for_lock_cache(opcode); src/mds/Mutation.cc:677-688 maps CREATE->CEPH_CAP_DIR_CREATE, UNLINK->CEPH_CAP_DIR_UNLINK
src/mds/Locker.cc:1184, 1187: the only 'new MDLockCache' and the only set_lock_cache_allowed; cleared only at src/mds/Locker.cc:1036; field starts at 0 (src/mds/Capability.h:387)

src/mds/Locker.cc:2563-2567 (Locker::get_allowed_caps) and src/mds/CInode.cc:3818-3822 (CInode::get_caps_allowed_for_client): for directories allowed &= ~CEPH_CAP_ANY_DIR_OPS, then |= lock_cache_allowed only if Fx allowed

All writers of Capability::_issued keep Dc/Dr off dir caps: issue_caps (src/mds/Locker.cc:2625, 2633, 2669-2671), encode_inodestat (src/mds/CInode.cc:4217-4229), confirm_receipt callers clip to issued() (src/mds/Locker.cc:3610-3613, 3776-3779), Export merge (src/mds/Capability.h:289-307)

Kernel clears ANY_DIR_OPS on directory caps before reconnect: linux/fs/ceph/mds_client.c:4931-4937 (reconnect_caps_cb); libcephfs reports cap.implemented: src/client/Client.cc:3492-3507 (Client::send_reconnect); libcephfs has no DIR_CREATE/DIR_UNLINK use and discards delegated inos (src/client/Client.cc:2164-2170)

Kernel falls back to synchronous ops without Fx|Dc / Fx|Dr: linux/fs/ceph/file.c:545 (try_prep_async_create), linux/fs/ceph/dir.c:1316 (get_caps_for_async_unlink); CEPH_MDS_R_ASYNC set only after those checks (linux/fs/ceph/file.c:914, linux/fs/ceph/dir.c:1420); nowsync is the default (linux/fs/ceph/super.h:50-53) and the kernel wants ANY_DIR_OPS on written dirs (linux/fs/ceph/caps.c:1056-1059)

History: 9b419b91f1b (2019) set lock_cache_allowed on the first synchronous create/unlink with no issued check (the original bootstrap); 9b4a93f2b7b (2024-03-05, merged by cc26800f668 on 2024-03-22) added the gate and calls the old behaviour a bug 'with no negative side-effects'; git log -G over src/mds and src/include/ceph_fs.h shows no later change to create_lock_cache, lock_cache_allowed, CEPH_CAP_DIR_*, CEPH_CAP_ANY_DIR_OPS or get_cap_bit_for_lock_cache

Tests: no file under qa/ or src/test/ mentions lock caches, DIR_CREATE/DIR_UNLINK, CEPH_MDS_FLAG_ASYNC or delegated inos; qa/suites/fs/workload/mount/kclient/wsync/no.yaml only sets the nowsync mount option, so QA does not detect the missing async path
